title: Toddler Sitting by Garden Flowers Under Tree, 1930s Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate outdoor snapshot depicting a toddler sitting atop a low stone border of a flower bed, sheltered under the canopy of a spreading tree. The child is dressed in a light-colored summer sunsuit romper and white laced shoes, looking down thoughtfully at something held in their hands. Blooming flowers surround the stone ledge, capturing a gentle moment of mid-20th-century domestic childhood.
